notes: No CPU value is inferred from wall time.
Main and output-local deployment reservation ledgers are both counted.
Outer run_suite child rusage takes precedence over Core queue child rusage and inner CLI CPU.
Score, plot and I/O jobs appear when recorded in JOB_LEDGER; unwrapped preparation/authoring/I/O CPU is not reconstructed.
The two normal_r0 post-seal receipt failures retain unknown CPU/RSS; exact reservation and queue wall costs remain.
This is a live aggregation for root review, not a scientific acceptance gate.
Legacy assembly circle_area is auxiliary pi*rx^2, not ellipse area; actual target_area/polygon_area quadrature uses rx*ry correctly. Frozen PDE source unchanged and no redo.

rss_summary.scope: Known recorded peaks only; two lost normal_r0 RSS receipts remain unknown. Guards were enforced, not used as measurements.

physics_ledger_policy: Only original R3 main ledger plus output-local deployment accounting ledgers are authoritative. Exploration mirrors are excluded.
